description: Every Exa search API feature, plus local history, spend tracking, and diffing no other Exa tool has.

novel_features.name: Spend report
novel_features.description: See cumulative API spend across every Exa call, broken down by day and resource.

novel_features.name: Monitor run diff
novel_features.description: Compare two synced monitor runs and see exactly which URLs are new, gone, or unchanged.

novel_features.name: Entity report
novel_features.description: Build a first-seen / last-seen / mention-count timeline for any company or person across your synced searches and webset items.

novel_features.name: Webset new
novel_features.description: List items added to a live webset since your last sync, so you only see what changed.
